explanation: On the success path the original returns the copied payload size (return *((_DWORD *)this + 3), the size at +0x0c, recovered/native/hexrays-all/chunk_052.c:15259) but the reconstruction always returns -1, and CEventQueueBase::GetEventData forwards that value (c_event_queue_base.cpp:22-24), so every delivered event looks like a missing/failed event to its consumers.
